entity.name: Glassbox Project Team
entity.description: The team stewarding Glassbox, an independent open-source Solana transparency and accountability toolkit.

projects.name: Glassbox
projects.description: An open-source Solana transparency and accountability toolkit for wallet inspection, transaction verification, funding transparency, downloadable reports, and auditable project records. Seeking $45,000 in non-dilutive public-good grant support for six months of development, RPC reliability, security review, documentation, pilot adoption, and maintenance. Glassbox has no token.

channels.description: Contact the project team to discuss grants and secure funding arrangements.

plans.name: Glassbox six-month public-goods grant
plans.description: A $45,000 non-dilutive public-good grant request over six months: $10,000 for RPC reliability and caching; $7,500 for the community proposal registry; $7,500 for security review and remediation; $10,000 for pilot adoption with five Solana projects; and $10,000 for adoption reporting and maintenance runway.
